title: I Live With Roaches
blurb: Delivered with such flat, matter-of-fact calm that it stops being a complaint and becomes a philosophy. The clip works because there is no shame in the voice whatsoever — the situation is simply reported, as one might report the weather — and the internet adopted it for admitting to any unglamorous truth about your flat, your finances or your standards. Honesty this bleak eventually loops back around to being genuinely funny. Play it when somebody asks how things are going and you have decided to answer them accurately for once.
